excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
Hey <@!308223150725005322> 🙂 You’re right, I don’t expect to return a 500 when the node is optimistically synced.

Regarding produceBlockv2, we don’t need to add a flag there since it’s impossible for BN to produce a block upon an optimistic parent (because it’s impossible for a EE to produce a payload atop an unknown parent).

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
Requesting an input on what should EL client respond with if `finalized` block is requested pre-Merge via JSON-RPC.

Related PR https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/200. Options:
- Refer to a block that is likely to stay in the PoW canonical chain forever, i.e. a block which is e.g. 128 blocks behind the head
- Respond with error
- Respond with genesis block
